messages.subject: make INLA-package:
parts:
While attempting to compile C code using a Makefile, I encountered the following error when executing the make INLA-package command:
复制
ser@user-virtual-machine:~/inla/r-inla-devel$ make INLA-package utils/build.package make: utils/build.package: Command not found Makefile:30: recipe for target 'INLA-package' failed make: *** [INLA-package] Error 127

This indicates that the make INLA-package command couldn't locate the utils/build.package script. After checking the source code you provided on GitHub, I confirmed that there's indeed no utils/build.package script present. The attached image shows the Makefile commands related to the utils/build.package script. How should I resolve this issue?

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] make INLA-package:
parts:
Precompiled versions of the package is available at inla.r-inla-download.org
and you also find precompiled version for various linux distributions as well

the inla-program, c/c++ code, is to involved for automatic compiling, so this is
why
